ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in East China changed by +0.098 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.069 to +0.127), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.242 mm/day.

ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in East China changed by +0.035 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.021 to +0.052), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.087 mm/day.

cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in East China changed by +0.23 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.10 to +0.36), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.58 mm/day.
